issues.description: The script uses GM_xmlhttpRequest and/or fetch to send data to discord.com (likely for the 'send to Discord' feature). This may include map pin data or user actions.
issues.recommendation: Ensure only intended, non-sensitive data is sent. Warn users about data transmission to third-party services.

issues.description: The script requests access to nominatim.openstreetmap.org, likely for reverse geocoding. While this is a public API, user location data (map pins) may be sent.
issues.recommendation: Disclose to users that their map pin/location data may be sent to OpenStreetMap servers.

issues.description: The script requests Notification API permission and uses Notification.permission, which can be abused for spam or phishing.
issues.recommendation: Limit notification usage to essential features and inform users.

issues.description: The script requests and uses GM_xmlhttpRequest, a high-privilege API, but only for the two declared domains. No evidence of over-privilege.
issues.recommendation: No action needed unless additional domains are added.

script_name: CheatGuessr Universal | GeoGuessr | OpenGuessr | WorldGuessr | FreeGuessr | GeoDuels
summary: This script transmits user map pin/location data to discord.com and nominatim.openstreetmap.org, which constitutes a critical data exfiltration risk. No evidence of privacy-invasive collection (e.g., cookies, keylogging), code obfuscation, or DOM XSS. Notification API is used, which is a medium risk. Permissions are appropriate for declared features. Supply chain risk is low as no @require is used. Overall, the script is high risk due to third-party data transmission.
